title: The Hidden Reason Your Phone Heats Up Overnight

scenes.text: Your phone can reach 45 °C while you sleep.
Background apps keep the processor active, generating heat even when the screen is off.
scenes.query: background apps cpu usage phone heat

scenes.text: Charging overnight forces the battery to cycle, releasing extra thermal energy.
Unplug & limit apps to keep it cool.
scenes.label: Cool Down Tip

scenes.text: Follow so you never run out of fun facts.

description: That warm feeling on your nightstand isn’t magic—it's background apps and overnight charging. Learn the hidden cause and a quick fix. Follow for more tech‑mystery facts!
